item.title: Japanese Garden Volunteer Day
item.description:
Thursday, July 16, 2026 at 9 AM

Location: Japanese Garden, Hermann Park Japanese Garden, Houston, TX, 77035, United States

Join us every Thursday for hands-on gardening projects at the Japanese Garden. From 9 a.m. to 12 p.m., come help with seasonal tasks like planting, weeding, mulching, and pruning. A great way to connect with others and make a visible impact in the Park! No experience needed. All ages are welcome. Click here to sign up!

From Hermann Park Conservancy

item.title: Sound Bath with Daemein Smith (Prioritizing Peace)
item.description:
Saturday, July 18, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: The Commons

Join us for a peaceful morning experience in Hermann Park with a free guided Sound Bath led by Daemein Smith of Prioritizing Peace. Set against the natural beauty of the Tsuru Family Terrace in the Commons, this immersive meditation experience uses sound and vibration to promote relaxation, mindfulness, and emotional well-being. Guests are encouraged to slow down, reset, and “Prioritize Peace” through a calming journey of sound healing in nature.  Tsuru Family Terrace Saturday, July 18  8 – 9 a.m.  Free Community Session Parking: Free parking available across the street from the Commons in Lot S (6215 Main St, Houston, TX 77030). Additional street parking available along Main Street. Guests are encouraged to bring a yoga mat if available. Blankets and pillows are also recommended for additional comfort. All ages and experience levels welcome.

From Hermann Park Conservancy
